description: Golden reference for 280 utility construction plans

pipes_total.description: Total number of pipes detected (exact match required)

total_length_lf.description: Total linear feet of all pipes (±3% tolerance)

avg_depth_ft.description: Average depth across all pipes (±5% for sampling resolution)

trench_volume_cy.description: Total trench volume in cubic yards (±5% for geometry sampling)

notes: These metrics were validated against manual takeoff
LF tolerance is ±2-3% due to vector precision and sampling
CY tolerance is ±5% due to geometry sampling resolution
Depth calculations use profile ground line when available
Seed value 42 ensures reproducible LLM detection results
